channel.title: Codehimblog – New software listings
channel.description: Codehimblog is an independent directory of free and open-source Windows software. Compare features, check Windows compatibility and find official download sources.

item.title: any_to_any.py – Audio & Video
item.description: Universal media converter that can convert, merge, concatenate and resize a wide range of audio, video, image and document formats on Windows.

item.title: Brovan – Developer Tools
item.description: Brovan is a user‑mode x86_64 emulator that lets you run, trace and analyze Windows and Linux binaries on Windows, Linux and Android.

item.title: ClamAV – Security & Privacy
item.description: ClamAV is an open‑source antivirus engine that scans for viruses, trojans, malware and other malicious threats.

item.title: DYGTube – Audio & Video
item.description: Download MP3 and MP4 files from online video services using a simple Windows interface.

item.title: ED Unofficial Patch – Games
item.description: Unofficial fixes and DLSS, FSR and XeSS upscaling for Elite Dangerous: Odyssey, in VR and flat

item.title: File Converter Pro – File Management
item.description: Free offline all‑in‑one file converter for Windows that handles documents, images, audio and video without uploading anything.

item.title: Foundation Sunshine – Games
item.description: Foundation Sunshine is a free open‑source remote streaming host that lets you view and control your Windows desktop, applications and games from another device with low latency, HDR and controller support.

item.title: Hydra Dragon Antivirus – Security & Privacy
item.description: An open‑source antivirus and endpoint detection and response tool that combines ClamAV, YARA, machine‑learning analysis and other security components for Windows.

item.title: iMA Menu – System Utilities
item.description: iMA Menu adds customizable context‑menu items, theming and a set of handy tools to the Windows desktop.

item.title: LibreSVIP – File Management
item.description: A universal converter for many Singing Voice Synthesis project formats.

item.title: New Pokemon Snap Recomp – Games
item.description: A native Windows version of New Pokémon Snap that runs your own legally obtained copy of the Switch game on PC with higher resolutions and frame rates.

item.title: OptiScaler – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: OptiScaler lets you replace or add upscaling and frame‑generation technologies in games that already support DLSS, FSR or XeSS, giving you more control over image quality and performance.

item.title: PS5 Dump Image Converter – Developer Tools
item.description: A graphical tool for converting, validating and managing PS5 and PS4 dump folders, image files and package containers on Windows.

item.title: Purffle Grab – Audio & Video
item.description: Free desktop downloader for YouTube, Spotify, TikTok, Instagram, SoundCloud and over a thousand other sites, allowing you to save videos and music as MP3, FLAC, MP4 up to 4K.

item.title: Raiden Video Ripper – Audio & Video
item.description: A simple Windows program for trimming videos and converting them to MP4, GIF, WebM or MP3 formats.

item.title: REAL Video Enhancer – Audio & Video
item.description: Easily interpolate, upscale, decompress and denoise videos.

item.title: Recompia – Games
item.description: Pokémon Pokopia (Switch 2) recompiled to run natively on Windows with multiplayer support.

item.title: SmoovPlay – Games
item.description: SmoovPlay streams console games to your PC and uses AI to generate extra frames, giving smoother playback at higher frame rates.

item.title: The Last Guardian Definitive – Games
item.description: A fan-made Windows port of The Last Guardian that adds photo mode, free camera, texture upgrades, controller support and many hidden features.

item.title: Upscayl – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: Free and open‑source AI image upscaler for Windows.

item.title: VideoCutter – Audio & Video
item.description: VideoCutter lets you download only a selected part of an online video or audio source as a separate file, without needing a video editor.

item.title: VideoLow – Audio & Video
item.description: VideoLow is a lightweight free GUI for FFmpeg on Windows that lets you compress, transcode and trim video and audio files.

item.title: Vitrine – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: A free, non‑destructive RAW photo editor for Windows that uses GPU acceleration and AI tools for upscaling and motion deblur.

item.title: Wynpix – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: A fast, GPU‑accelerated image viewer for Windows that supports modern formats, AI upscaling, HDR tone‑mapping and a batch converter.

item.title: Altered Audio Editor – Audio & Video
item.description: A free, open‑source multitrack audio editor designed for podcasters and voice‑over work, with tools for recording, editing, mixing and exporting audio projects.

item.title: Amber – Audio & Video
item.description: Amber is a free, open-source non-linear video editor that focuses on speed and ease of use, offering GPU‑accelerated rendering and a lightweight binary.

item.title: ApkStart – System Utilities
item.description: ApkStart lets you run Android apps on Windows as separate native windows, with one‑click installation from an APK file.

item.title: Arara – Productivity & Office
item.description: Arara is a free, open‑source voice dictation app that works locally and pastes transcribed text wherever the cursor is placed.

item.title: Aula – Productivity & Office
item.description: A free, open‑source desktop study app that turns your lecture notes, slides, PDFs or exam files into AI‑generated lessons, quizzes, flashcards and mock exams.

item.title: Axe – Developer Tools
item.description: A lightweight command‑line tool that runs focused LLM‑powered agents defined in simple configuration files.

item.title: BenchUp – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: BenchUp is a free, open‑source 3D modeling program for woodworking and furniture design, letting you plan boards, joints and assemblies with exact measurements.

item.title: Codecast – Productivity & Office
item.description: Codecast is a desktop workspace that lets teams collaborate with AI coding agents, combining chat, calls, tasks, documents and version control in one interface.

item.title: DeckCraft – Productivity & Office
item.description: DeckCraft is an open‑source presentation creator that lets you design, edit and present slide decks with themes, shapes, media and export options.

item.title: DeepSeek Harness Desktop – Developer Tools
item.description: An open‑source Windows desktop client that provides a graphical interface for the DeepSeek Harness AI model, with built‑in plugins, skills, SSH access and customizable skins.

item.title: dsh-TUI – Productivity & Office
item.description: An interactive terminal user interface for DeepSeek Harness that adds a pixel‑whale header, live status panels and shortcut commands to the command line.

item.title: Estella – Developer Tools
item.description: Estella is a fast 2D and 3D game engine with a visual editor that can be driven by AI agents and can export projects to web, desktop, and mobile platforms.

item.title: gptme – Developer Tools
item.description: A personal AI agent that runs in the terminal, able to write code, use the web, run shell commands and more, with support for many AI models.

item.title: HyCanvas – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: An open‑source Canva‑like editor that runs in the browser and can be self‑hosted.

item.title: Immage – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: Immage is a raw photo editor that provides familiar panels, sliders and shortcuts for editing photos, built on darktable.

item.title: Kjarni – Developer Tools
item.description: Kjarni is a local AI inference engine that lets Windows users run transformer models for tasks like embeddings, classification, search, chat and more, directly on their computer without internet after the first download.

item.title: KLineChartQuant – Productivity & Office
item.description: A high‑performance financial charting program for Windows that displays fast, smooth candlestick charts and lets users add indicators, drawings and AI‑driven analysis.

item.title: L-MPV – Audio & Video
item.description: A modern, lightweight portable video player for Windows built on the MPV engine with a glass‑morphic interface and optional AI upscaling.

item.title: Lime – Productivity & Office
item.description: Full-stack AI agent for coding, files, terminals, tools, research, content, multimodal work, and multi-agent workflows.

item.title: Loudr – Productivity & Office
item.description: Offline text‑to‑speech and voice typing tool for Windows that reads selected text aloud and converts spoken words into typed text.

item.title: Masterpiece – Audio & Video
item.description: An open‑source pipe organ sample player that works with Hauptwerk and GrandOrgue sample sets.

item.title: Motty – Networking Tools
item.description: Motty is a desktop SSH client that combines terminal, SFTP, port forwarding, remote desktop and an AI assistant in a single window.

item.title: Murmure – Productivity & Office
item.description: A privacy‑first speech‑to‑text program that runs entirely on your computer, supporting 25 languages without sending any data online.

item.title: Noobot – Productivity & Office
item.description: Noobot is a self‑hosted AI agent workspace that lets you run chat‑based workflows, use built‑in tools, and create 3D character animations from plain language prompts.

item.title: OpenAgentd – Developer Tools
item.description: OpenAgentd is a desktop application that runs a coding assistant locally, showing every tool call, file change and terminal output while you work on a project.

item.title: OpenECraft – Productivity & Office
item.description: OpenECraft is an open‑source electrical computer‑aided engineering editor that lets you create schematics, generate reports and design panel layouts in 3D.
